cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've brought tissues. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.

mechanism: A coaches its former pupil through shared job loss with increasingly urgent comfort while its own tears and shaking defeat the capable-teacher pose.
confusable: Not merely helping despite sadness: B repeatedly exposes A distress and A answers by offering more care to B.
comparison: Shared layoff versus shared choir rejection.
seedUse: D117 tissues/sleeve/box/hands/tea; S05 old difficult-call breathing habit.
